activity_summary: After the comedy you stood with John, Kemp, and Garnish. You had played Navarre. The yard was thin, and John would not set a figure. Kemp had added nothing. Garnish left the tally where it was, nineteen lines and a noise like a goose. You opened no second matter. Kemp and John did not hear the king.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Left the tally standing and opened no second matter.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Added nothing, and did not ask what the morning had been.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Refused a figure for a thin yard.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: Nineteen lines, and a noise like a goose.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: I am not setting a figure on a thin yard, and I will not borrow one.
